rag_samples.question: How does my Earned Leave accrue every month?
rag_samples.reference: Earned Leave accrues at the rate of 1.25 days per month after completion of one year of continuous service (minimum 240 working days). Employees in their probation period accrue EL at 0.5 days per month, which becomes available only after probation confirmation.
relevant_contexts: Earned Leave is accrued based on the length of continuous service. Employees become eligible for 15 days of Earned Leave upon completion of one year of continuous service, provided they have worked for a minimum of 240 days in that year. Thereafter, Earned Leave accrues at the rate of 1.25 days per month. Employees in their probation period accrue EL at 0.5 days per month, which becomes available for use only after probation confirmation.

rag_samples.question: How much Earned Leave can I carry forward to next year?
rag_samples.reference: A maximum of 45 days of Earned Leave may be carried forward at the end of each financial year (31 March). Any balance exceeding this limit will be automatically encashed at the employee's basic daily rate and credited in the April payroll.
relevant_contexts: A maximum of 45 days of Earned Leave may be carried forward at the end of each financial year (31 March). Any balance exceeding this limit will be automatically encashed at the employee's basic daily rate and credited in the April payroll.

rag_samples.question: How many weeks of Maternity Leave am I entitled to?
rag_samples.reference: Female employees who have completed a minimum of 80 days of service in the 12 months preceding the expected date of delivery are entitled to 26 weeks of paid Maternity Leave for the first two live births. For a third child, the entitlement is 12 weeks. Up to 8 weeks of pre-natal leave may be availed prior to the expected delivery date.
relevant_contexts: Female employees who have completed a minimum of 80 days of service in the 12 months preceding the expected date of delivery are entitled to 26 weeks of paid Maternity Leave, in accordance with the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017. This entitlement applies to the first two live births. For a third child, the entitlement is 12 weeks. Up to 8 weeks of pre-natal leave may be availed prior to the expected delivery date.

rag_samples.question: Do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
rag_samples.reference: Yes, Sick Leave taken for more than 2 consecutive days requires a Medical Certificate from a registered medical practitioner, to be submitted within 3 working days of returning to work.
relevant_contexts: Sick Leave taken for more than 2 consecutive days requires a Medical Certificate from a registered medical practitioner, to be submitted within 3 working days of returning to work.

rag_samples.question: What date does my salary get credited every month?
rag_samples.reference: Salaries and professional fees are processed and credited to the employee's registered bank account by the 7th of the following month. The payroll cut-off date is the 24th of each month.
relevant_contexts: Salaries and professional fees are processed and credited to the employee's registered bank account by the 7th of the following month. Any changes to payment dates for a given month will be communicated to employees in advance by the Payroll team. The payroll cut-off date is the 24th of each month.

rag_samples.question: What's the salary range for an L4 Senior employee?
rag_samples.reference: The CTC range for an L4 (Senior) grade employee is Rs. 16.0L to Rs. 26.0L per annum, with a bonus target of 10% of CTC.
relevant_contexts: L4 Senior Rs. 16.0L to Rs. 26.0L 10% of CTC

rag_samples.question: What medical insurance coverage does the company provide?
rag_samples.reference: Zyro Dynamics provides Group Medical Insurance with coverage of up to Rs. 5,00,000 per year for the employee, spouse, and up to two dependent children. All premiums are fully paid by the Company. Additionally, Personal Accident Insurance covers 5 times the annual CTC and Term Life Insurance covers 3 times the annual CTC.
relevant_contexts: Group Medical Insurance: Coverage of up to Rs. 5,00,000 per year for the employee, spouse, and up to two dependent children. All premiums are fully paid by the Company. Personal Accident Insurance: Coverage equivalent to 5 times the employee's annual CTC. Term Life Insurance: Coverage of 3 times the annual CTC for all permanent employees.

rag_samples.question: When am I put on a Performance Improvement Plan?
rag_samples.reference: An employee who receives a rating of 1 or 2 in two consecutive review cycles will be placed on a formal Performance Improvement Plan. The PIP lasts 60 to 90 days with specific, measurable improvement targets, weekly check-in meetings, and HR Business Partner oversight.
relevant_contexts: An employee who receives a rating of 1 or 2 in two consecutive review cycles will be placed on a formal Performance Improvement Plan. Duration: 60 to 90 days, as determined by the reporting manager and HR Business Partner. Weekly check-in meetings between the employee and the manager are mandatory throughout the PIP period.

rag_samples.question: What's the timeline for the Annual Performance Review?
rag_samples.reference: The Annual Performance Review (APR) runs from February to April: 360-degree feedback (1-20 Feb), employee self-assessment (1-10 Mar), manager assessment (11-20 Mar), calibration meeting (21-25 Mar), final ratings locked (26-31 Mar), one-on-one feedback (1-10 Apr), and increment/promotion letters issued on 15 April.
relevant_contexts: 360 degree feedback collected from peers and subordinates: 1 to 20 February. Employee self-assessment submitted on ZyroHR portal: 1 to 10 March. Manager completes assessment and submits draft rating: 11 to 20 March. Calibration meeting held with all L6 and above managers: 21 to 25 March. Final ratings locked and confirmed by HR: 26 to 31 March. One-on-one feedback conversation between employee and manager: 1 to 10 April. Increment and promotion letters issued: 15 April.

rag_samples.question: Am I eligible to work from home at my grade?
rag_samples.reference: WFH is available to permanent employees at grade L3 and above who have completed 6 months of continuous service and have a performance rating of Meets Expectations or above. Employees on probation, at grades L1 and L2, and those deployed at client sites are not eligible unless approved by the HR Director.
relevant_contexts: This policy applies to all permanent employees at grade L3 and above across all Zyro Dynamics office locations. Employees on probation, employees at grades L1 and L2, and employees deployed at client sites are not eligible for WFH arrangements unless approved in writing by the HR Director on a case-by-case basis.

To be considered for a WFH arrangement, an employee must satisfy all of the following: Completed a minimum of 6 months of continuous service at Zyro Dynamics. Currently holding grade L3 or above. Has received a performance rating of Meets Expectations or above in the most recent performance review cycle.

rag_samples.question: Can I accept a gift from a client or vendor?
rag_samples.reference: Receiving a gift under Rs. 1,000 is permitted but must be declared to the reporting manager. Receiving a gift over Rs. 1,000 must be politely declined or surrendered to HR. Client-hosted meals are permitted up to Rs. 3,000 per person. Accepting cash from any party is never permitted — zero tolerance with immediate disciplinary action.
relevant_contexts: Receiving a gift under Rs. 1,000: Yes, must be declared to the reporting manager. Receiving a gift over Rs. 1,000: No, must be politely declined or surrendered to HR. Client-hosted meal: Yes, value must not exceed Rs. 3,000 per person. Accepting cash from any party: Never, immediate disciplinary action, zero tolerance.

rag_samples.question: What are the password rules for company systems?
rag_samples.reference: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long, include upper-case, lower-case, numeric, and special characters, must be changed every 90 days, and must not repeat any of the last 5 passwords. Sharing passwords is strictly prohibited and constitutes a serious policy violation.
relevant_contexts: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long, include upper-case, lower-case, numeric, and special characters. Passwords must be changed every 90 days and must not repeat any of the last 5 passwords. Sharing passwords is strictly prohibited.

rag_samples.question: How do I raise a POSH complaint and what's the timeline?
rag_samples.reference: A complaint can be filed in writing to any member of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) or through the confidential POSH helpline at icc@zyrodynamics.com. The ICC must complete the inquiry within 90 days of receiving the complaint. The employer must act on the ICC's recommendations within 60 days.
relevant_contexts: A complaint can be filed in writing to any member of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) or through the confidential POSH helpline. The ICC must complete the inquiry within 90 days of receiving the complaint. The employer must act on the ICC's recommendations within 60 days.

rag_samples.question: How much notice period do I need to serve to resign?
rag_samples.reference: The notice period depends on your grade: L1 to L3 must serve 30 days, L4 to L6 must serve 60 days, L7 to L9 must serve 90 days, and L10 (C-Suite) is 90 days as per individual employment contract. Notice period buyout is available at the Company's discretion for L4 and above.
relevant_contexts: L1 to L3: 30 days, notice period buyout not available. L4 to L6: 60 days, buyout available at the Company's discretion. L7 to L9: 90 days, buyout available at the Company's discretion. L10 (C-Suite): 90 days, as per individual employment contract.

rag_samples.question: What's my hotel and daily allowance for international travel?
rag_samples.reference: For international travel: L3 to L4 get USD 120/night hotel and USD 60/day allowance. L5 to L6 get USD 180/night and USD 90/day. L7 to L8 get USD 220/night and USD 120/day. L9 to L10 get USD 350/night and USD 200/day. All expenses must be submitted within 7 working days of return with original receipts.
relevant_contexts: International travel entitlements: L3 to L4 Economy class, USD 120 hotel per night, USD 60 daily allowance. L5 to L6 Economy flexible fare, USD 180 hotel, USD 90 daily. L7 to L8 Economy flexible fare, USD 220 hotel, USD 120 daily. L9 to L10 Business class, USD 350 hotel, USD 200 daily.

rag_samples.question: How do I apply for a job opening at Zyro Dynamics?
rag_samples.reference: Zyro Dynamics posts open positions on its careers page at www.zyrodynamics.com. Interested candidates can apply through the website. The onboarding process begins with an offer letter and appointment letter upon acceptance, followed by collection of joining documents, background verification, laptop provisioning, and a 90-day onboarding programme covering orientation, role ramp-up, independent contribution, and full productivity phases.
relevant_contexts: Issue offer letter and appointment letter: HR, upon offer acceptance. Collect joining documents: education, identity, and experience proof: HR, 7 days before joining. Initiate background and reference verification: HR / Agency, 7 days before joining. Provision laptop and grant system access: IT, 2 working days before joining.

rag_samples.question: Can you tell me my ESOP vesting schedule?
rag_samples.reference: Employee Stock Options (ESOP) are offered to employees at grade L5 and above, with a 4-year vesting schedule on a 1-year cliff basis. Processing of vested ESOP shares is also part of the Full and Final Settlement on separation.
